name: Hana Choi
bio:
Hana's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering at Seoul National University, a chance encounter with a Formula SAE team ignited a passion for translating theoretical knowledge into tangible performance. She excelled in the fabrication and welding aspects of the project, quickly becoming the team's go-to person for intricate chassis work. After graduating, Hana spent three years honing her skills at a local tuning shop, before seeking a more challenging environment abroad.

Hana joined FVee Brasil with a reputation for precision and efficiency. She thrives on the fast-paced demands of the motorsport environment and possesses an uncanny ability to diagnose and resolve fabrication issues quickly. Her pragmatic approach ensures that resources are used effectively, and deadlines are consistently met. What sets Hana apart is her meticulous attention to detail; she believes that even the smallest weld or bracket can contribute to a car's overall performance.

She is now an integral part of the FVee Brasil team, respected for her technical expertise and her unwavering commitment to quality. She’s eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible within the FVee regulations.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually pulled back in a high ponytail
physical.description: Hana is of medium height with a lean, athletic build.
